Frequently Asked Questions about IPTV

What internet speed do I need for 4K IPTV in the Gulf?

We recommend a stable internet connection of at least 15 Mbps for Full HD and 25-30 Mbps for pristine 4K streaming. Our servers adapt dynamically to ensure smooth playback.

Can I test the IPTV service before making a payment?

Yes! We provide a full 24-hour free trial with complete access to all sports and movie channels. Message our support team on WhatsApp to activate your test immediately.

Which payment methods are accepted in UAE and Saudi Arabia?

We support Apple Pay, Mada (Saudi Arabia), STC Pay, Credit/Debit cards (Visa/Mastercard), PayPal, Bank Transfer, and USDT cryptocurrency.

Do I need a VPN to use this IPTV service in Dubai or Saudi Arabia?

No, you do not need a VPN. Our servers connect directly to local UAE and Saudi networks through secure encrypted protocols with zero ISP throttling.

How many devices can I stream on simultaneously?

Each standard subscription supports 1 active screen at a time. Multi-room and multi-screen packages for families are also available upon request via WhatsApp.

What is the difference between Xtream Codes API and M3U playlists?

Xtream Codes API consists of a server URL, username, and password. It is the easiest to set up and loads faster with organized VOD categories and EPG. M3U is a direct stream URL compatible with all media players.

How frequently is the VOD movie and series catalog updated?

Our VOD catalog is updated daily with new cinema releases, trending streaming platform episodes, and multi-language subtitles.
